findingClass: a live IPO row bound on nothing stronger than its normalised name (no CIN, no exchange symbol, no ISIN) — the OD-34 name-bound flag
failThreshold: any offering_type=IPO row in status UPCOMING/OPEN with no cin, no symbol, and no isin
unverifiableWhen: never — always runs against the ipos table
note: Implements OD-34: 'the nightly audit reports the name-bound rows by name — never as a count.' A name-bound row may not be auto-merged with another name-bound row.
